parent_objective: design a source-construction branch that first proves hidden dynamics require different actions under matched current observations
blocked_by: M1240 closes the same-source extreme/fault path after no-signal sequence evidence
supersedes: more same-source extreme/fault hidden-swap or sequence variants
invalidates: assuming hidden-dynamics randomization automatically creates self-ID-critical cases

public_gates: M1241 may design source construction only
M1241 must preserve actor input contract
M1241 must not use private holdout
M1241 must keep hidden dynamics and oracle/source labels out of deployable actor inputs
M1241 must define a bounded first implementation step
forbidden_shortcuts: do not add hidden parameters or oracle labels to actor inputs
do not claim self-identification from source construction alone
do not use a rule controller as a deployable actor

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: opens a new branch that validates action separability before actor history tests
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: process/design only; no training, promotion, private-holdout, paper-level, recurrent-belief, or self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if source construction depends on oracle labels as actor inputs
stop if action separability gates are not defined
stop if first implementation step is too broad to validate
fallback_plan: narrow to one hidden-dynamics axis first
use a small action-sequence lattice before adding optimizers
route to simulator extension only if current model cannot create separable cases
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1240 opens the capability-separable source construction branch

admission_evidence: M1238 no-signal result suggests random/proxy fault sources do not guarantee history-critical cases
M1240 requires proving hidden dynamics action separability before actor self-ID tests
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, review, and next manifest
next_stage_criteria: bounded first implementation step is selected

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1241 is source-construction design and does not yet test actor history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: future actor tests must still use human-view inputs only
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: Self-ID evidence remains blocked until source-separable cases are constructed and actor history interventions pass.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If current simulator cannot create action-separable hidden-dynamics cases, record the limitation and route to simulator extension or task redesign.
allowed_claims: no recurrent-belief, strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, real-vehicle, or paper-result claim

hypothesis: A source-construction branch that first proves hidden dynamics require different actions is higher leverage than more random hidden-fault intervention tests.
success_criteria: first bounded implementation step is selected
no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, profile tuning, or actor-input contract expansion occurs
failure_criteria: hidden dynamics labels are added to actor inputs
decision_rule: M1241 passes if it defines a bounded action-separable source-construction route with actor-input guardrails and a concrete first implementation step.
